locator.title: Топ-6 аттракционов в «Острове Мечты» для фаната экстрима
locator.caption: После «Бешеного танца» земля еще пару минут кажется ненадежной

nearest_text_before.text: На этом аттракционе вы забудете о земном притяжении. Гигантский диск вращается, приводя в движение 16 двухместных кабинок — и каждая живет своей жизнью: крутится, раскачивается, меняет угол. Скорость неумолимо растет, а вас прижимает то в одну сторону, то в другую — остается только держаться покрепче.

image_reading: A brightly lit indoor amusement ride with glossy red-and-blue enclosed cabins on a rotating platform.
The central cabin carries a smiling adult and child leaning together into the ride’s motion; other riders and cabins remain visible around them.
The image already conveys speed, circular movement, and lively family excitement.
analysis.article_context: Body image for the fifth-ranked attraction “Бешеный танец”: it illustrates the escalating spin and unstable, thrilling pull of its independently moving cabins, with riders holding on through the ride.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation conveys the thrill of the “Бешеный танец,” where spinning cabins make riders feel pulled from side to side.
structured_intent.primary_action: The ride’s cabins continue rotating through a sustained circular turn while the riders lean with the motion.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The prominent foreground cabin is visibly entering its next curve while still rotating with the ride.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The riders remain securely seated and visibly exhilarated by the ride until the last frame.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the central cabin continues its moderate circular sweep with the surrounding cabins following the same ride motion. The riders make only a natural shared lean with the turn while keeping their excited expressions. A fixed camera preserves the recognizable central cabin; near the end it arrives visibly into the next curve, still moving steadily.
models.positive_prompt: The rotating ride carries the central red cabin smoothly along its circular arc as the riders lean with the turn, holding their excited smiles; fixed camera, with the cabin still clearly visible and settling into the next turn in the final frame.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second interpretation, the ride’s rotation develops as one even, sustained turn. The foreground cabin travels around the platform while nearby cabins provide continuous secondary rotation; the riders subtly brace into the curve without additional gestures. The fixed framing keeps the family and cabin focal point readable until it reaches the next visible bend at the end.
models.positive_prompt: The central cabin sweeps through a sustained turn on the spinning ride, its riders leaning into the force with excited smiles. Fixed camera; end with the cabin clearly entering the next curve, still in motion.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, focus on the immediate, continuous sweep of the foreground cabin around the ride. Its riders respond with one restrained lean while the surrounding cabins shift in matching circular motion. Keep the camera fixed so the foreground cabin remains the anchor, ending as it visibly carries into the following curve with the same exhilarated energy.
models.positive_prompt: The foreground cabin glides through a lively circular turn, with its riders naturally leaning into the motion and maintaining their excited smiles. Fixed camera; the final frame shows the cabin clearly continuing into the next curve.
